units.rawText: Professor! Octogen, reporting for duty! Is there anything you need me to demolish? The HQ? The living quarters... or maybe someone's secret lair?

units.rawText: Hold your horses! Put down your detonator. We're not discussing demolitions today, Octogen.

units.rawText: I give Octogen a quick rundown about the memory fragment and its recovery process.

units.rawText: Oh, so you want to hear about our first encounter... That day, Simo introduced me to you, Professor. He always spoke so highly of you, calling you special, so I thought I'd see for myself.

units.rawText: The demolitions done that day was truly a disaster. None of the procedures were executed according to plan, achieving nothing but scaring off Simo's little ferret... Neither Simo nor you showed any expression—you just stood there, watching. Couldn't you at least pretend to be impressed?

units.rawText: Octogen, your skills have always impressed me, whether it's your precise calculations for explosives, or the thorough safety protocols you follow. It was because of the work you performed that day that I decided to put you in charge of the demolition team.

units.rawText: Phew... Professor... I have a little secret I'd like to share with you.

units.rawText: I actually hate using explosives for combat... Indeed, I know very well that this technology owes much of its progress to war. Still, I'll make sure everyone's weapons are in top form for the battles ahead.
